title: Debugging
description: Find and fix bugs in web code: read the symptom, locate the cause, and make or direct a targeted fix.

checkpoints.title: Symptoms and causes
checkpoints.description: Read a symptom, guess where the cause lives, and fix planted bugs.

panels.caption: A bug shows up as a symptom: text runs together, a color is missing, a button does nothing.
Each symptom points at a place in the code. HTML controls what is on the page, CSS how it looks, JavaScript what it does.
Name the symptom, guess the cause, make one change, check the result. Repeat.

starterFiles.index.html:
Fix me

This page has three bugs.

Find them and fix them.

steps.title: Fix it!
steps.instructions:
This page has three bugs:

1. Two paragraphs run together.
2. The heading should be blue, but is not.
3. The button does nothing when clicked.

Fix as many as you can. You can edit the code yourself or describe the bug and ask the AI for a fix. Either way, name the symptom before you change anything.

validation.successCriteria: At least two of the three planted bugs are verifiably fixed.

checkpoints.title: Debugging strategy
checkpoints.description: Reflect on how to choose which bug to attack first.

steps.title: Your debugging strategy
steps.description: Reflection closing the skill. There are no wrong answers.

questions.prompt: How did you decide which bug to attack first, and what would you try first next time?
